table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PA.AdmissionCode,
	PA.PatientCode,
	Customer  = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=P.CustCode),
	PatientRegNo=P.RegNo, 
	PatientName=P.Name, 
	Address = P.Address1,
	City = P.City,
	PA.Diagnosis, 
	Doctor=(SELECT Doctors.Name FROM Doctors WHERE Doctors.DoctCode = PA.DoctorCode), 
	Disease=(SELECT Disease.Name FROM Disease WHERE Disease.DiseaseCode = PA.DiseaseCode), 
	AdmissionDate=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT Users.UserName FROM Users WHERE Users.UserCode = PA.UserCode),
	InitialDischarged=PA.Discharged1,
	InitialDischargedDate=PA.Discharged1On,
	FinalDischarged=PA.Discharged,
	FinalDischargeDate=PA.DischargedOn,
	FinalDischargedBy=(SELECT Users.UserName FROM Users WHERE Users.UserCode = PA.DischargedBy),
	Location = L.Name,
	WardCode=L.WardCode,
	WardName=W.Name,
	DischargeReason=(SELECT DR.Name FROM DischargeReason DR WHERE DR.DischargeReasonCode = PA.DischargeReasonCode)
FROM 
	PatientAdmission PA, 
	Patient P, 
	PatientLocation L,
	Ward W,
	(SELECT 
		PA.AdmissionCode, 
		LocationCode = ISNULL((SELECT TargetLocation FROM PatientTransfer 
									WHERE PatientTransfer.TransferCode = 
											(SELECT Max(PatientTransfer.TransferCode) 
											FROM PatientTransfer 
											WHERE PatientTransfer.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode)), (SELECT A.LocationCode FROM PatientAdmission A WHERE A.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode))
	FROM PatientAdmission PA
	WHERE 
		CASE :ai_PatientStatus WHEN 1 THEN PA.Date ELSE PA.DischargedON END >= :ad_StartDate AND 
		CASE :ai_PatientStatus WHEN 1 THEN PA.Date ELSE PA.DischargedON END <= :ad_EndDate) PAL
WHERE 
	PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	CASE :ai_PatientStatus WHEN 1 THEN PA.Date ELSE PA.DischargedON END >= :ad_StartDate AND 
	CASE :ai_PatientStatus WHEN 1 THEN PA.Date ELSE PA.DischargedON END <= :ad_EndDate AND
	PA.AdmissionCode = PAL.AdmissionCode AND
	PAL.LocationCode = L.LocationCode AND
	L.WardCode = W.WardCode

ORDER BY
	Customer,
	AdmissionDate,
	FinalDischargeDate,
	WardName,
	Location,
	PatientName
